$schema_note: Run-configuration for scripts/municipal-ingestion-engine.mjs. Layered ON TOP of data/municipal-park-sources.json (the discovery/research registry) — this file never duplicates discovery facts, only adds the operational fields needed to actually execute a source through the generic pipeline. A row here with enabled:true is a claim 'this source is SAFE_OPEN and its schema is known well enough to run generically' — never set enabled:true for a source whose license_status in municipal-park-sources.json is not SAFE_OPEN.
